## HN discussion (0 comments)

(no comments)
{"decision": "pass", "reason": "这是一个普通的心情记录网页工具，数据仅存浏览器、无同步，页面只展示标准的日历、选择心情和导出功能，没有体现特别巧妙的产品角度、垂直场景或独到的呈现方式，也没有可借鉴的新颖之处。"}

verdict.reasoning: The reason says data stays only in the browser with no sync, and that the page offers a calendar, mood selection and export. The page text states all of these (local storage, no cloud backup or sync, calendar, five mood levels, JSON/CSV export), and these specific details support the pass decision.
